complicacoes.texto: Once Hourman takes a Miraclo pill, his Powers last exactly an hour, and no more. In addition, he can’t take another pill until an hour after his Powers fade.

Rex Tyler became severely addicted first to the rush of heroic adventure, and then to the drug that gave him his Powers. Eventually, the only way to break his addiction was to retire from being Hourman and pass the legacy on to his son Rick. Using Miraclo caused Rick Tyler to contract leukemia, and he retired from heroics. On the verge of death, he was saved only by the arrival of an Hourman from the far-future, who took Rick out of time to bring him back to health and reintroduce him to his father.
